neighbours.label: A coordinator (and / but / but not) that joins two verb predicates sharing one argument ('read but not discussed the chapter', 'present and discuss'), vs 'and'/'but' joining nouns or adjectives
fire: In the second chapter we describe and compare four sampling methods.

predictions: Verb-verb coordination 0.4-0.9 on the coordinator or 'not'; noun-noun and adjective-adjective coordination under 0.1.
short: and/but joining two verbs on one argument
notes: Card: ' and' x18, ' not' x5, ' but' x2 in 'but not fully excavated', 'exists but is empty', 'get and set', 'present and discuss'.
